answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost that cannot be shared across clones. Concrete design: each grader seat requires a refundable bond, and an attestation only counts after a bridge of randomized checkers — one lantern in the dark, drawn per batch — re-audits a sample. Seats refresh each epoch, so a clone army arrives with no history and a glacier of unbonded kinship to thaw before it earns anything. A proven false grade burns the seat bond and locks the lane. Faking votes then costs real capital per identity, scaling with clone count, while honest agents bond once.
